titel: S5, Ep94: BONUS: 10 perfect days on PEI

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: A recap of a trip to Prince Edward Island and the L.M. Montgomery Conference.
kurzfassung: The co-hosts review their summer trip to Prince Edward Island, detailing visits to historical sites linked to L.M. Montgomery and their experiences at the biennial conference. They share highlights from museum tours, interviews with relatives of the author, and hosting trivia events. The episode concludes with reflections on various academic presentations and recommendations for listeners.
stichpunkte: Discussion of summer reading lists, including cozy fantasies and nonfiction books about family influencers
Overview of traveling to PEI from Los Angeles and staying near Cavendish
Touring Green Gables Heritage Place, the Biddeford Parsonage, and the Lower Bedeck School
Visiting the author's birthplace and the Anne of Green Gables Museum in Park Corner
Interviewing L.M. Montgomery's grandniece, Pam Campbell
Hosting a trivia and game night at the conference with special guest appearance by Megan Follows
Attending academic paper presentations on topics ranging from legal custody in novels to pop culture comparisons
Participating in the conference banquet and closing plenary sessions

clips.hook: Finding familiar titles in a blind date book display
clips.text: The speaker notices that books wrapped up as blind date selections are titles she has already read repeatedly.

clips.hook: Family reactions to a historical journal revelation
clips.text: Descendants of a local individual expressed deep offense after published diaries described their ancestor negatively.

clips.hook: Nerves before a major conference appearance
clips.text: Anticipating a prominent actress's attendance at their hosted event caused the hosts immense anxiety and sleeplessness.

beschreibung:
In today’s episode, we relive our unforgettable adventure to Prince Edward Island where we walked in L.M. Montgomery's footsteps, explored beloved Anne of Green Gables sites, and met the historians, scholars, and Montgomery family members who help keep her legacy alive. We are also taking you with us to the L.M. Montgomery Institute’s Biennial Conference, sharing highlights from our favorite sessions, including those we hosted! If you are planning your own pilgrimage to PEI, join us for travel tips, recommendations, and memorable moments.

Thank you to:

Green Gables Heritage Place

Lyn Dean and Janice Trowsdale at the Bideford Parsonage Museum

Doug Sobey at the Lower Bedeque School

Catherine McEachern at the L.M. Montgomery Birthplace

Pam Campbell at the Anne of Green Gables Museum

Everyone with the L.M. Montgomery Institute who put on the most fantastic conference!

Inspired by:

Kelly is inspired by Snoozeband for easy sleep on long flights! And by the Hot and Bothered podcast for their deep dive on Persuasion!

Ragon is inspired by the best grilled cheese sandwich she’s ever had at Gallant's & Co on PEI (and their amazing chicken pot pie!). She’s also inspired by the Good Molecules Caffeine Eye Patches to beat jet lag!
